name: George
output_format_note: mp3_44100_192 is Creator tier and above. The v1 render used mp3_44100_128, the highest format available on the Free tier.
selection_rationale: Final voice is the existing v1 ElevenLabs George render. The v2 George/Adam first-line test could not run because the free tier returns HTTP 401 detected_unusual_activity on synthesis. George was already selected over Brian in v1 for this material: warm, clear British storyteller, less heavy than Brian's deeper read. Reusing v1 George keeps the final voice consistent and avoids the blocked v2 synthesis path.

blocker.message: Unusual activity has been detected on your account, so Free Tier access has been disabled. This can be triggered by using a proxy or VPN, or by creating multiple free accounts.
blocker.impact: No new v2 George render. The final cut uses the existing v1 George audio and v1 timestamps; no local placeholder audio remains in the final path.
blocker.note: The key authenticates: GET /v1/user/subscription and GET /v1/voices return 200. Only synthesis is blocked. No characters were consumed by the rejected requests.

character_usage.note: Failed 401 requests are not billed. Reusing v1 George uses no ElevenLabs characters.

future_option.note: The final cut uses the existing v1 George render. A future paid/unique-IP ElevenLabs run could use generate-v2-vo-elevenlabs.mjs, but no retry is planned now.
